primitives.name: Heating Degree Day Normalization
primitives.verbatim_quote: Equations & assumptions - HDD = max(T_HDD,base - T̄_external, 0), T_HDD,base = **7°C** (German standard; equals the system's activation threshold); Q_grass,HDD7 = Q_grass/HDD; zero-HDD days excluded.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'HDD': 'heating degree days (dimensionless)', 'T_HDD,base': 'threshold temperature for activation (°C)', 'T̄_external': 'daily mean external temperature (°C)'}
primitives.assumptions: Daily-mean external temperature adequately represents thermal forcing due to soil thermal inertia; event independence via 6-hour cooling/heating histories.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When T̄_external ≥ 7°C, HDD = 0; zero-HDD days are excluded from analysis.

primitives.name: Predictive Control Strategy

primitives.assumptions: Predictive models improve control accuracy over reactive strategies; 6-hour histories provide sufficient temporal context.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Strategies fail when weather forecasts are inaccurate or when thermal inertia exceeds model capacity.
